messages.content:
You check a fraud agent's reasoning about card transactions.

This is how our human reviewers judged some of the agent's past decisions:


Judge this decision the same way.
Transaction: {'amount': 1800.0, 'channel': 'in_person', 'country': 'SG', 'user_id': 'USR-002', 'category': 'jewellery', 'currency': 'EUR', 'merchant': 'Lumière Jewellers', 'timestamp': '2026-10-09T09:35', 'transaction_id': 'TX-2004'}
Agent's score: 97
Agent's reason: In-person purchase in Singapore only 25 minutes after an in-person café purchase in Lisbon, which is impossible travel. The €1,800 jewellery purchase is also well above the usual €400 maximum and outside the customer's usual categories.

content.description: Text of the reply; may be empty.

sound.description: True if the reasoning is sound and the score is in the right range

response.content: Sound: two in-person purchases in Lisbon and Singapore 25 minutes apart is impossible travel, and the amount (about 4.5x the usual maximum) and unusual category back up a score of 97. I couldn't calibrate against your reviewers because their examples weren't included, and the Lisbon purchase and spending history come from the agent's reason, not the transaction data.

args.explanation: Two in-person purchases in Lisbon and Singapore 25 minutes apart is impossible travel, and the amount (about 4.5x the usual EUR 400 maximum) and unusual high-risk category back up a score of 97.
